% Printed versions of the metadata commands supplied by the web plugin.
%
% Unlike the classic print shim (which discarded the metadata), the PDF build
% renders each \lean{} annotation as a line of clickable links into the Lean
% sources on the GitHub mirror, \leanok as a "Lean-verified" badge, and
% \uses{} as a "Uses" cross-reference line.  The declaration -> URL map is
% generated by blueprint/gen_leandecls.py into macros/leandecls.tex.

\usepackage{xcolor}
\definecolor{leanok}{RGB}{27,122,62}
\definecolor{leanpending}{RGB}{176,93,0}

\input{macros/leandecls.tex}

\newcommand{\discussion}[1]{}
\newcommand{\mathlibok}{}

% One declaration name: hyperlink to its source if the map knows it,
% plain typewriter otherwise.  Underscores are typeset via \textunderscore and
% the name may break (with no hyphen) after dots and underscores.
\ExplSyntaxOn
\NewDocumentCommand{\LeanDeclName}{m}
 {\group_begin:\ttfamily
  \tl_set:Nn \l_tmpa_tl {#1}
  \tl_replace_all:Nnn \l_tmpa_tl {_} {\textunderscore\allowbreak}
  \tl_replace_all:Nnn \l_tmpa_tl {.} {.\allowbreak}
  \tl_use:N \l_tmpa_tl
  \group_end:}
\ExplSyntaxOff
\newcommand{\LeanDecl}[1]{%
  \ifcsname leanurl@#1\endcsname
    \href{\csname leanurl@#1\endcsname}{\LeanDeclName{#1}}%
  \else
    \LeanDeclName{#1}%
  \fi}

% Status badges.  \leanok appears in a fragment only once the corresponding
% Lean proof is sorry-free; a statement without \leanok is stated in Lean but
% its proof may still be pending.
\newcommand{\leanok}{\par\noindent{\small\textcolor{leanok}{\checkmark~Lean-verified}}\par\ignorespaces}
\newcommand{\notready}{\par\noindent{\small\textcolor{leanpending}{$\circ$~Lean proof pending}}\par\ignorespaces}

\ExplSyntaxOn
% \lean{a, b, c} -> "Lean: a, b, c" with each name hyperlinked.
\NewDocumentCommand{\lean}{m}
 {\par\noindent\begingroup\small\raggedright
  \emph{Lean:}~
  \bool_set_true:N \l_tmpa_bool
  \clist_map_inline:nn{#1}
   {\bool_if:NTF \l_tmpa_bool
     {\bool_set_false:N \l_tmpa_bool}
     {,~}%
    \LeanDecl{##1}}%
  \par\endgroup\ignorespaces}
% \uses{l1, l2} -> "Uses: (S)1.2, (S)3.4" via the fragments' labels.
\NewDocumentCommand{\uses}{m}
 {\par\noindent\begingroup\small
  \emph{Uses:}~
  \bool_set_true:N \l_tmpa_bool
  \clist_map_inline:nn{#1}
   {\bool_if:NTF \l_tmpa_bool
     {\bool_set_false:N \l_tmpa_bool}
     {,~}%
    \S\ref{##1}}%
  \par\endgroup\ignorespaces}
\NewDocumentCommand{\proves}{m}
 {\clist_map_inline:nn{#1}{\vphantom{\ref{##1}}}%
  \ignorespaces}
\ExplSyntaxOff
